title: BetterPotato
description: Make potato PCs and Macs look and run better Minecraft
body:
# BetterPotato

A pack that optimizes your game, as well as making it look better!

Complementary Shaders is used to make the game look better. Turn on the Potato profile in game for good graphics and performance.
In version 2.0, Beryl shaders is he replacement for Complementary Shaders

Soduim and Lithium are included to make your game faster. This pack has been mostly tested on MacOS.


<details>
<summary>Mods/packs included</summary>

Cherished Worlds

Clearer Menu Buttons

Iris Shaders (Not in version 2.0)

Fantasy Shaders and Complementary Shaders (Fantasy Shaders and Complementary Shaders not in version 2.0)

Soduim (or Vulkanmod for version 2.0)

Lithium and Soduim Extra (Lithuim and Soduim Extra are not in version 2.0)


</details>
